Kerala Singer Nisar Wayanad Dies Suddenly in Dubai Before Performance

Nisar Wayanad, a singer from Kerala known for his voice resembling Udit Narayan, died suddenly in Dubai at the age of 44. His death occurred hours before he was scheduled to perform at a show in Ajman. An Instagram post from his official account was also shared.
